runtimeDeployment.installNotes: Signed Debug with local team 9G4K6N63MK / bundle com.wiseungcheol.aura.face3dlab (committed team G7X4226T2Q has no account on this Mac). App loaded JS over WiFi after the Mac LAN IP changed; recovered by re-aliasing the baked packager IP. See AGENTS.md iOS Real-Device Build & Verify.

runtimeSmoke.poseGateFix: Replaced session-space trackingFace.localEulerAngles with camera-relative deviation (new Aura.Face3D.Face3DHeadPose) that auto-resolves the ARFoundation 0-vs-180 frontal convention; frontal capture that previously stalled at 0/30 now reaches 30/30. Also raised RN result grace to clear the 12s Unity acquisition timeout and stopped the G5 status message from starving pose guidance.
runtimeSmoke.qualityNote: chinProjection aggregated only 18 inliers (<20 minimum) at 0.36 confidence; least-reliable metric this run. Low confidences (0.36-0.57) are the expected consequence of the confirmed 3xMAD outlier rule biting a very tight MAD, not bad data. Aggregation is a confirmed boundary and was left unchanged.

deviceEvidence.finding: Open jaw / expression frames rejected on device; neutral face still reaches 30/30. No regression.

G2.implementation: Aura.Face3D.Face3DNeutralExpressionGate (pure, fail-open) plus Face3DSessionController reading ARKit blend shapes (jawOpen, mouthSmile, mouthFrown, mouthPucker, mouthClose, browInnerUp, browDown, cheekPuff) and rejecting a frame whose strongest distorting signal exceeds 0.5. When blend shapes are unavailable the gate fails open so the G1 extraction cannot regress to 0/30.
G2.localTests: Face3DNeutralExpressionGateTests (7 cases) within the 52-case EditMode suite (passed)

deviceEvidence.finding: sessionSequence advanced monotonically to 19 within a single app process (no reset), so >=10 native<->Unity round trips completed with 0 crash/jetsam/freeze.

G3.implementation: sessionSequence counter incremented per StartFace3DAnalysisJson and emitted on every face3d_status event (RN type and parser updated), so a stress run is countable from the evidence log.

deviceEvidence.method: Auto-clustered recent device captures into 3 groups (no subject labels in the log; G3 same-person repeats inflate one cluster), then within/between MAD discriminability.
deviceEvidence.finding: 4 of 5 metrics separate people well (>=4.3). chinProjection does NOT discriminate (0.5): between-person spread is smaller than repeat noise, consistent with its low-inlier / low-confidence behavior in the G1 smoke. Do NOT expose chinProjection as a user-facing trait until improved. A clean, subject-labelled 3x3 capture set (no G3 repeats mixed in) should confirm.
deviceEvidence.recommendation: For a rigorous pass, recapture 3 people x 3 neutral measurements in a fresh session, label subjects in a manifest, and run npm run face3d:repeatability.

G4.implementation: scripts/face3d/analyze-repeatability.mjs computes per-metric within-subject vs between-subject MAD and discriminability = between/within (npm run face3d:repeatability).

deviceEvidence.message: 얼굴은 한 명만 프레임 안에 두어야 합니다.
deviceEvidence.finding: Two people in frame produced 191 multiple_faces_detected blocks on device and collection never proceeded.

G5.implementation: Face3DTrackingFaceGate classifies >=2 tracking faces as Multiple; ProcessLatestFaceFrame rejects with multiple_faces_detected and never collects. requestedMaximumFaceCount=2 lets ARKit actually surface a second face to block.
G5.localTests: Face3DMultipleFaceGateTests (7 cases) plus the existing TrackingFaceGate cases (passed)

chinMetricRedefinition.change: chinProjection now projects the fixed-index chin centroid onto the face-spanning midface plane (like noseTip/central), replacing the chin's own neighbor plane, in both Face3DMetricEvaluator.cs and evaluate-semantic-candidate.mjs.
chinMetricRedefinition.evidence: Labelled 3-subject offline test (raw-vertex captures): chin between-person discriminability improved to 23.7 (C1) vs 16.5 (old); dispelled the earlier confounded on-device G4=0.5 and the ARKit chin-capacity-ceiling worry. Unity EditMode 52/52 + offline evaluator + repeatability tests pass with updated golden (chin 0.25->0.5).
chinMetricRedefinition.deferred: Device rebuild/verify skipped per user; jaw-translation gate hardening (jawForward/jawLeft/jawRight) deferred to next device cycle.

localValidationG2ToG5.note: Every gate stays device-evidence-pending per the project rule that code existence never passes a gate. See ARKit_FACE3D_LAB_IMPLEMENTATION_KO.md for the consolidated one-pass device protocol.
